About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

As a Senior Product Analyst you’ll work closely with Tide’s product teams to use data to drive product adoption. You’ll work within the product analytics team to use data to inform our collective understanding of users, their problems and thus inform product strategy.

This role will suit an individual that can operate with a high degree of independence and has hands-on experience of proactively working with the product community. You are an expert and constructive critique of digital products with strong views on data-driven techniques to improve adoption and engagement of various products & features. You will be working as a part of the product squad with a functional reporting into the Lead of Growth Product Analytics.

Some Of The Things You’ll Be Doing

• Product Discovery - hypothesis driven deep dives (existing product usage data) to identify user problems, quantify size of the problem and highlight solution(s) to impact revenue.
• Solution Confidence - product experiments are a means to an end. They help us produce data to build confidence on the product & features we plan to invest in. You would be the champion of product experimentation and would observe data, propose, design and analyse product experiments.
• Product and Feature Performance Review - new features solve user user problems and drive product usage and thus adoption. You would work with product teams to identify features that need to be shipped, scaled or killed.
• User Research - solving user problems helps us achieve commercial goals. You would identify opportunities, perform data deep dives (exploratory and hypothesis driven) to improve our collective understanding of user problems and assist working groups to focus on and prioritise high impact user problems. 
• Goals to KPI Translations - you would work with product managers to break overall revenue goals into business KPIs, identify impact hypotheses and convert into measurable product KPIs. You would work with analytics engineers to enable KPI reporting through visually speaking dashboards.
• Experimentation & Product Growth - you will operate with a high degree of user behaviour awareness (backed by consistent event data observation) and assist product managers by designing experiments to drive product adoption. You would use custom data analysis and statistical methods to analyse experiment results. 
• Self Serve Product Analytics - partner with data, engineering, data product and data science teams to deliver a world-class self-serve event data analytics platform for app and web products. Our experimentation stack includes platforms like LaunchDarkly for shipping variants, Segment for events, Heap for visualisation. You would be required to partner with data-science teams to build a stats-engine for relevant KPIs for each product enabling a seamless self-serve analytics for business and product teams.

What We Are Looking For

• 5-10 years of experience working on Product Analytics for a digital product.
• Strong hold on product strategy, experimentation, roadmapping, & prioritisation
• You are a consumer tech geek, preferably fintech (not mandatory).
• You are a natural storyteller with exceptional presentation skills.
• You believe and invest time in project management and have exceptional people skills. 
• You understand and believe user experience is a product.
• You are humble enough to know that you need to learn, and confident enough to showcase your skills, speak your mind and even challenge the status quo.
• You have an intrinsic need to be excellent but have learnt to be action oriented.
• You have failed and can talk about it at length. 
• You have excellent SQL proficiency and are willing to crunch complex numbers.
• You are a self starter and can operate with a high degree of independence. 
• You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast paced environment.

What You’ll Get In Return

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model & Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:

• Competitive salary 
• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• Employee Assistance Programme
• 12 casual & 15 Privilege leaves
• We invest in your development with professional L&D budget per year
• Spacious office in Hitechcity with all day snacks
• 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
• Hybrid working 
• Sabbatical leave 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Job Description – Research Analyst / Senior Research Analyst – US Equities

Location: Mumbai

Department: Research

Experience: 3–8 Years

Industry: Capital Markets / Equity Research / Investment Banking / Asset Management

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced US Equity Research Analyst to conduct in-depth fundamental research and analysis of US-listed companies and sectors. The role involves identifying investment opportunities, developing financial models, analysing market trends, and delivering actionable research insights to support investment and trading decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Equity Research: Conduct fundamental research on US-listed companies, sectors, and industries to identify investment opportunities.
• Financial Modelling & Valuation: Develop and maintain financial models, earnings forecasts, and valuation frameworks using DCF, comparable company analysis, and other relevant methodologies.
• Market Analysis: Monitor US equity markets, macroeconomic developments, Federal Reserve policies, earnings announcements, and sector-specific trends.
• Investment Recommendations: Generate actionable investment ideas, stock recommendations, and research reports supported by detailed analysis.
• Earnings & Portfolio Tracking: Analyse quarterly earnings, company guidance, financial performance, and key business developments.
• Research Publications: Prepare company initiation reports, earnings updates, sector outlooks, and market commentaries.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Research Head, trading desks, and investment teams to provide timely market insights and research support.
• Risk Assessment: Evaluate company-specific, sectoral, valuation, and macroeconomic risks associated with investment recommendations.

Desired Candidate Profile

• 3–8 years of relevant experience in equity research, preferably covering US equities or global developed markets.
• Strong understanding of US equity markets, listed companies, sector dynamics, and investment strategies.
• Hands-on experience in financial modelling, financial statement analysis, and company valuation.
• Ability to independently research companies, build investment theses, and generate actionable stock ideas.
• Familiarity with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet, Capital IQ, or similar financial databases.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, report-writing, and presentation skills.
• Understanding of US market regulations, corporate disclosures, and financial reporting standards.
• Willingness to work flexible hours to accommodate US market developments, earnings announcements, and business requirements.

Educational Qualifications

• MBA / PGDM in Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
• CFA / CA or equivalent professional qualifications preferred.

Preferred Candidate Background

Professionals from equity research firms, institutional broking houses, investment banks, asset management companies, hedge funds, or global research teams with direct exposure to US-listed equities.

Key Hiring Requirement: Candidates must have hands-on experience in fundamental equity research, financial modelling, and valuation, with the ability to independently generate well-researched investment ideas on US-listed companies. Direct US equity coverage experience will be strongly preferred.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

Team's Impact

The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.

Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.

Role Overview

The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

What You'll Do

Customer & Product Discovery

• Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities. 
• Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts. 
• Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes. 

Product Development & Execution

• Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 
• Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle. 
• Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements. 
• Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality. 

Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership

• Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities. 
• Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions. 
• Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues. 
• Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams. 

Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement

• Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics. 
• Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities. 
• Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials. 
• Support internal training and client enablement initiatives. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes. 
• Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience. 
• Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset. 

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. 
• 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
• Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
• Experience working in Agile software development environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered 
• Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows. 
• Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman). 
• Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation. 
• Experience supporting integrations with Power BI, Snowflake, or similar analytics and data platforms. 
• Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications. 
• Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows. 

Key Competencies

Insights

• Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions. 

Strategy

• Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy. 

Execution

• Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration. 

Technical Expertise

• Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows. 

Leadership & Collaboration

• Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams. 

Career Progression

Product Specialist → Senior Product Specialist → Associate Product Manager → Product Manager → Senior Product Manager

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

• The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
• Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days. 
• Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives. 
• A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions. 
• Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. 
• Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. 
• Learn more about our benefits here. 

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

Job Title: Data Analyst

Experience: 5+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data and analytics initiatives by translating complex commercial business processes into accurate analytical models and SQL logic. The role requires strong expertise in SQL, cloud data environments, data visualization and commercial analytics.

The candidate will work closely with business teams to understand requirements, validate data and develop reliable dashboards and analytical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Translation & SQL Development

• Translate complex commercial processes such as sales, seasonal rebate programs, sales returns and marketing campaign performance into accurate and documented SQL logic.

• Write, optimize and maintain complex SQL queries and views using Amazon Redshift and Databricks.

• Extract, transform and validate data to support reporting, visualization and analytics initiatives.

• Map and validate data across systems including SAP SD, Salesforce and digital business platforms.

• Ensure business rules and commercial processes are accurately represented in the data layer.

Commercial Analytics & Dashboarding

• Design, build and maintain QlikSense dashboards.

• Develop analytical models to track regional commercial KPIs.

• Analyze sell-in and sell-out data to identify market trends, demand patterns and potential inventory issues.

• Perform deep-dive analysis of sales campaigns, loyalty programs and promotional effectiveness.

• Provide actionable insights to support business decisions.

Data Quality & Governance

• Collaborate with data engineering teams to optimize data pipelines, tables and views in Databricks and Redshift.

• Develop validation queries to identify data anomalies and ensure data quality and consistency.

• Validate analytical results against source systems.

• Support accurate and reliable data consumption for BI and analytics teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics or a related analytical role.

• Strong expertise in SQL, including complex joins, CTEs and query optimization.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Redshift and/or Databricks.

• Experience working with large datasets in cloud data environments.

• Good knowledge of QlikSense or similar data visualization tools.

• Understanding of data warehousing concepts, including Star/Snowflake schemas and dimensional modelling.

• Experience working with commercial, sales and marketing data.

• Understanding of Order-to-Cash, distributor/retailer channels, pricing, sales incentives and marketing campaign tracking.

• Experience with source systems such as SAP SD and Salesforce/SFDC.

• Strong data validation and analytical skills.

• Ability to translate business requirements into technical SQL specifications.

• Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

• Experience in AgTech, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG or related manufacturing/distribution environments is preferred.

• Experience working with structured distribution networks and commercial datasets is an advantage.
